findings.claim: The START→dungeon flow ordering is: (1) MASTER OPTIONS → START NEW GAME (enter); (2) scenario pick screen (enter selects the only/default scenario); (3) scripted entry narration — a modal sequence of text prompts each dismissed by ENTER; (4) first controllable dungeon frame (game_state=5, party at entrance). The narration requires ~10 ENTER taps to fully dismiss in a 3-member party run. game_state stays 5 throughout; the narration is NOT a separate game_state, it is a wmaze-internal modal.
